title: Landmark registry build
desc: Core system (Fable tier, task text of P0-023). DELHI_WORLD.md section 1 and section 10 "Landmark registry pipeline" (LM1, LS2). The tier score proposes hero, signature or marker (named by Anmol, ASI listed, Wikidata sitelinks, footprint size, seen from an arterial or a hero road); Anmol's list and inspector edits win. title: Landmark placement pipeline
desc: Core system (Fable tier). DELHI_WORLD.md "Placement rules" and section 10 (LP2, HM2). tools/bake/landmarks/place.ts. Inside a block a landmark sits at the block offset plus its projected position in the block frame. Take the footprint and the orientation from the OSM footprint (principal axis, or an override). Fit a flattened pad or plinth into the ground and re-cut the ground around it. Mark the landmark zone and replace the buildings inside it (logged). Lay the surroundings as ground classes (lawns, forecourt, walls, a moat line). Write pins into the tiles. Hook up the LOD slots: the hero LOD chain and one far silhouette under 2,000 triangles. Outside every block a far landmark stands on the backdrop on its real bearing as a silhouette, and is never a place the player can reach. At most 2 heroes at full detail in view, as data the streaming system reads. Pillar: the city opens up.
accept: Position test in the block frame for every registry entry with a high position confidence: hero within 5 m and 5 degrees, signature within 10 m, marker within 15 m (perf_budgets.json world)
Pad test: the ground under each pad is flat within 0.05 m and meets the ground around it with no gap over 0.02 m
No generated or plain building stands inside a landmark zone (count 0; the replaced ones are in the log)
Relative layout: India Gate to Red Fort and India Gate to Connaught Place keep bearing within 0.5 degrees and distance within 0.5%
A far landmark is never inside a reachable tile (test); the bake gives the same tile hashes twice and tiles stay inside the byte budget
npm run typecheck and npm test are green

title: Area profile generator: parcels, building shells, facade placements and edge blending
desc: Core system (Fable tier: the area profile generator). DELHI_WORLD.md "The generator (Fable tier)" and section 10 "Area profile pipeline" (AG1, EB1); TECH.md "Rendering of the city". tools/bake/areas/generator.ts, at bake time, written into the tiles. Parcels from the repaired footprints and the block faces (subdivide a block where footprints are missing). Building shells with heights from OSM tags where present and otherwise from the profile's floor counts, roof types and setbacks, one collider shell per building. Facade module placements (bays, by the profile's mix) as tile placements with custom data for tint and wear. Every pick is seeded from the world tile and a parcel id made from the footprint (tools/bake/rand.ts), so a rebake gives the same city. Edge blending: inside each area's blend band the generator mixes the two profiles by distance, shorter at roads and rail.
